infobox.usage: Unlocks office no. 4 on the second floor of the TerraGroup building complex on Ground Zero.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: TerraGroup science office key (Science) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the science office inside the TerraGroup main building in the city center.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: The office can also be entered through the window from the adjacent office no. 3 by climbing on the window sill, not requiring this key.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- This is a required location for the quest Saving the Mole
- Used in the story chapter Blue Fire

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Ground Zero
sections.text: On the lab scientist in the TerraGroup main building. He can be found in a hallway behind the big TerraGroup sign in the entrance hall, buried under rubble. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to office no. 4 on the second floor of the TerraGroup main building at Ground Zero.
